headlines.title: Federal Reserve’s Jerome Powell says ‘the time has come’ for US interest rate cuts – as it happened
Fed Chair Powell Signals ‘Time Has Come’ for September Rate Cut
headlines.abstract: Jerome H. Powell made it clear that the Federal Reserve will cut rates on Sept. 18, as the central bank turns the corner in its fight against inflation.

headlines.title: What will a Federal Reserve interest rate cut mean for you?
Fed chair Jerome Powell says US interest rate cut has nothing to do with election – as it happened
The Fed Makes a Large Rate Cut and Forecasts More to Come
headlines.abstract: Fed officials kicked off rate cuts with a half-point reduction, confident that inflation is cooling and eager to keep the job market strong.
